description_en: Call the BanLiveMessageGroup operation to mute a user
kebab_example: aliyun live ban-live-message-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --except-users uid3 --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
name: BanLiveMessageGroup

parameters.help_en: The users who are exempt from the group-wide mute. Specify up to 30 users. Separate multiple user IDs with a comma (,)
parameters.help_zh: 当开启全员禁言时不被禁言的用户。多个用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多不超过30个
parameters.name: except_users

parameters.help_en:
The data center. This value must be the same as the data center that you specified when you called https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html.

The supported data centers are China (Shanghai) (cn-shanghai) and Singapore (ap-southeast-1)
parameters.help_zh:
数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致。
当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center
